🏆✨ A big congratulations to our Miami Qigong Performance Team, “A Million Dreamers,” for receiving the Rising Star Award at the 2nd National Qigong Competition at #BEFestival2026! ✨🏆

Our performance carried a simple but powerful message: when we hold onto a dream and work together with one heart, we can make the impossible possible. 🌟

A heartfelt thank you to every member of our team for your dedication, effort, and courage — especially for stepping onto the stage and performing in front of more than 300 people! ❤️‍🔥

Through this journey, we learned so much more than a performance. We learned how to work as one team, how to become more flexible in our minds and bodies, how to overcome challenges together, and how to express our hearts through a deeply emotional and touching performance. 🫶

And a very special thank you to @bodynbrain.us for creating and hosting such an incredible event. 🙏✨ It was truly an unforgettable experience, and we grew so much through this opportunity.

We’re leaving with fuller hearts, stronger connections, and even bigger dreams. 💫

We already can’t wait to come back and participate again next year!

A Million Dreamers — keep dreaming, keep growing, and keep making the impossible possible. 🌎✨

#AMillionDreamers #BEFestival2026 #Qigong #Qigongcompetition

🌋✨ Day 1 of our Brain Education Festival in Sedona ✨🌋

Before arriving at @sedonamagoretreat, we began our journey together with a visit to one of Sedona’s most powerful vortex sites — Cathedral Rock. ❤️‍🔥

We trained together, hiked through the breathtaking red rocks, and took time to slow down, breathe, and reconnect with the Earth. 🌎✨

Sedona is a truly special place — a place where the spirit of the Earth feels alive and present. A place that invites you to remember who you are, reconnect with yourself, and ask deeper questions about life and the path you are walking. 🌿

So grateful for all of our beautiful members who had the courage and openness to step into this adventure together. 🤍

This is only Day 1… and the journey has just begun. ✨
